title: Nephrotic Syndrome (腎病症候群)
sources: First Choice 醫學(三) - 腎臟疾病各論 (p.58-100)

sections.title: Overview / Epidemiology
content: Nephrotic syndrome 是以 **massive proteinuria** 為主要表現的腎絲球疾病症候群，定義為蛋白尿 > 3.5 g/day (或 urine protein/creatinine ratio > 3.5)。

content.text:
Nephrotic syndrome 四大特徵：
1. Proteinuria > 3.5 g/day
2. Hypoalbuminemia (< 3.0 g/dL)
3. Peripheral edema
4. Hyperlipidemia

content: 好發率因病因而異。在兒童，**Minimal Change Disease (MCD)** 佔 70-90%；在成人，**Membranous Nephropathy** 和 **Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis (FSGS)** 最常見。

content.text: Primary (Idiopathic) Causes
Secondary Causes

**Systemic diseases:** SLE (Class V), DM, Amyloidosis
**Infections:** HBV (Membranous), HCV (MPGN), HIV (FSGS)
**Drugs:** NSAIDs (MCD), Gold, Penicillamine (Membranous)
**Malignancy:** Solid tumors → Membranous; Lymphoma → MCD

sections.title: Pathophysiology
content: 核心機制：**Glomerular basement membrane (GBM) permeability 增加** → 大量白蛋白從尿液流失。

content.text:
Nephrotic syndrome 的 pathophysiology cascade:
Proteinuria → Hypoalbuminemia → Decreased oncotic pressure → Edema
同時 liver 代償性增加 lipoprotein 合成 → Hyperlipidemia
Urinary loss of antithrombin III + increased clotting factors → Hypercoagulable state

content:
**Podocyte injury** 是 nephrotic syndrome 的核心病理：
- MCD: Podocyte foot process effacement (可逆)
- FSGS: Podocyte loss → sclerosis (不可逆)
- Membranous: Immune complex deposition on GBM subepithelial side

rows: Subendothelial (Type I) or dense deposits (Type II)

content.text:
LM normal + IF negative + EM shows foot process effacement = MCD，不是 FSGS！
FSGS 在 LM 上可見 focal segmental sclerosis，但早期 biopsy 可能 miss (sampling error)

items: **Periorbital edema** (especially morning) → Peripheral edema → Anasarca
Frothy urine (from proteinuria)
Weight gain (from fluid retention)
Fatigue, malaise

content.text:
Nephrotic edema 好發於 periorbital area (早晨) 和 lower extremities (下午)，和 nephritic edema 的差異在於：
- Nephrotic: oncotic pressure 下降 → transudative edema
- Nephritic: salt/water retention → volume overload
Complications

items: **Thromboembolism**: Renal vein thrombosis (especially Membranous), PE, DVT
**Infection**: Loss of immunoglobulins → 特別是 encapsulated bacteria (Streptococcus pneumoniae)
**Hyperlipidemia**: LDL, VLDL 升高；HDL 可能正常或降低
**AKI**: Hypovolemia, bilateral renal vein thrombosis

content.text:
Nephrotic syndrome + 突然 flank pain + hematuria → 要想到 **renal vein thrombosis**！
最常見於 Membranous Nephropathy

sections.title: Diagnosis

content.text: Lab Findings

items: **Urinalysis**: Proteinuria (3+ to 4+), oval fat bodies, fatty casts, maltese cross under polarized light
**24-hr urine protein** > 3.5 g/day 或 **UPCR** > 3.5
**Serum albumin** < 3.0 g/dL
**Lipid panel**: Total cholesterol, LDL 升高
**Complement levels**: C3/C4 (正常 in MCD/FSGS/Membranous; 低 in MPGN/SLE)

content.text:
Complement levels 的鑑別診斷：
- C3 低, C4 正常: MPGN Type II, Post-infectious GN
- C3 低, C4 低: SLE (Class V), Cryoglobulinemia
- C3/C4 正常: MCD, FSGS, Membranous, Diabetic
Kidney Biopsy

content: Kidney biopsy 是確定診斷的 gold standard，**但兒童若臨床高度懷疑 MCD 可先 empirical steroid treatment**，response 本身即可做為診斷。

content.text: General Measures

items: **ACE inhibitor / ARB**: 降低 proteinuria (first-line for all)
**Dietary sodium restriction**: < 2 g/day
**Loop diuretics** ± albumin infusion for severe edema
**Statin** for hyperlipidemia
**Anticoagulation**: Consider if albumin < 2.0 g/dL or Membranous

content.text: Disease-Specific Treatment

**First-line**: Prednisolone 1 mg/kg/day × 4-8 weeks → taper
**Relapse**: Repeat steroid course
**Frequent relapse / Steroid-dependent**: Cyclophosphamide, Calcineurin inhibitors (Cyclosporine/Tacrolimus), Rituximab
**Response rate**: > 90% remission with steroids

**Observation**: Moderate proteinuria (< 4g) → ACEi/ARB × 6 months
**Immunosuppression indications**: Proteinuria > 4g after 6 months, declining GFR
**Regimen**: Ponticelli protocol (alternating Steroids + Cyclophosphamide × 6 months) 或 Rituximab
**Anti-PLA2R antibodies**: Monitor for treatment response

**First-line**: Prednisolone (longer course than MCD, 4-6 months)
**Steroid-resistant**: Calcineurin inhibitors (Cyclosporine + low-dose prednisone)
**Prognosis**: 50% progress to ESRD in 5-10 years if untreated
ACEi/ARB 是所有 nephrotic syndrome 的 first-line 降蛋白尿藥物，和 specific immunosuppressive therapy 同步使用

sections.title: Prognosis / Follow-up
content: Follow-up 重點：定期監測 proteinuria (UPCR), serum albumin, renal function (eGFR), lipids。

sections.title: Special Populations

content.text: 兒童

content: 兒童 nephrotic syndrome 絕大多數是 MCD (70-90%)，可先 empirical steroid therapy 不需 biopsy。Biopsy indications: steroid resistance, age < 1 or > 12, low C3, renal failure。

content.text: 孕婦

content: Pregnancy 會惡化 proteinuria。ACEi/ARB 為 **pregnancy category D**，孕期禁用，改用 methyldopa 或 nifedipine 控制血壓。

content.text: 老年人

content: 老年人 nephrotic syndrome 要特別排除 **malignancy** (Membranous) 和 **amyloidosis**。

content.text:
常考鑑別：
1. 兒童 + nephrotic → **MCD** (先用 steroid)
2. 成人 + nephrotic + PLA2R Ab (+) → **Membranous**
3. African American + nephrotic + HIV → **FSGS**
4. DM > 10 yr + nephrotic → **Diabetic Nephropathy**
5. Nephrotic + renal vein thrombosis → **Membranous**

Nephrotic vs Nephritic 比較：
- Nephrotic: Proteinuria > 3.5g, hypoalbuminemia, edema, hyperlipidemia
- Nephritic: Hematuria (RBC casts), mild proteinuria, HTN, oliguria
- Mixed: MPGN, SLE can present with both

必背：各 nephrotic disease 的 pathology hallmark
- MCD: Foot process effacement only (LM/IF negative)
- FSGS: Focal segmental sclerosis
- Membranous: Spike and dome, subepithelial deposits
- MPGN: Tram-track (double contour GBM)
- Diabetic: Kimmelstiel-Wilson nodules

items: Maltese cross under polarized light = **lipiduria** (nephrotic syndrome)
Oval fat bodies = **renal tubular cells with fat** (nephrotic)
Anti-PLA2R = **primary Membranous Nephropathy** marker
兒童 MCD steroid response rate > 90%
ACEi/ARB 是所有 nephrotic syndrome 的基本治療
